product.name: Monoprice UL Power Cord Splitter - NEMA 5-15P to 2x NEMA 5-15R 16AWG 13A/1625W 3-Prong Black 1.2ft
product.description: This Power Cord Splitter by Monoprice offers a practical solution for connecting two devices to a single power outlet effortlessly. With its smart Y‑splitter design, it surpasses the limitations of a conventional power strip by providing just the right number of connections while maintaining convenience.The power cord features a three‑prong NEMA® 5‑15 plug, ensuring secure and grounded power connections for your devices. Its reliable construction boasts a sturdy 16 AWG cable designed to handle a considerable load of up to 13 amps or 1625 watts at 125 volts.Designed with versatility in mind, this power cord splitter features a NEMA® 5‑15P plug type that fits most standard power outlets. It offers two NEMA® 5‑15R receptacles, allowing you to effortlessly power two devices simultaneously from the same power source.Crafted with durability in mind, the power cord splitter is built with high‑quality SJT jacket material. This robust jacket material ensures longevity and protection against wear and tear, making it suitable for various environments and applications.The power cord splitter consists of three conductors, providing a reliable and stable connection for your devices. It employs a 16 AWG wire gauge, which is designed to efficiently transmit power and handle the demands of everyday use.Safety is a top priority, and this power cord splitter has obtained various certifications to ensure peace of mind. It is UL® and cUL certified, meeting the safety standards set by reputable organizations. Additionally, it is CSA® and RoHS compliant, further attesting to its quality and adherence to industry regulations.Whether you need to power multiple devices in your home office, entertainment center, or any other setup, this Monoprice Power Cord Splitter is a dependable and convenient solution.
